scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "yarn workspace @vestpayouts/web dev" "yarn workspace @vestpayouts/api dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @vestpayouts/api typecheck && yarn workspace @vestpayouts/web build
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "yarn workspace @vestpayouts/web start" "yarn workspace @vestpayouts/api start"
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @vestpayouts/api typecheck && yarn workspace @vestpayouts/web typecheck
